pr_title: fix(test runner): serial suites inside parallel suite should run in parallel

comments:
Please, see if this helps.

https://playwright.dev/docs/test-parallel#parallelize-tests-in-a-single-file

```javascript 
test.describe.configure({ mode: 'parallel' });
```

@ltsuda thanks for your answer.

Unfortunately, this particular doc section doesn't resolve my problem. 
replacing `test.describe.parallel(...)` with `test.describe.configure({ mode: 'parallel' });` changes nothing in my case. 

Besides, 
I'd like a test file to have two (or more) test suites where _tests share the same page instance and run in serial mode_, while _the test suites run alongside_:
WORKER #1 => Test Suite A: Test A1 -> Test A2 (page instance A is created once, shared among the Test A1 and  Test A2)
WORKER #2 => Test Suite B: Test B1 -> Test B2 (page instance B is created once, shared among the Test B1 and  Test B2)
